items.title: Police investigate Married at First Sight Australia after 'inappropriate' allegations
items.description: New South Wales Police say inquiries took place "following a report of inappropriate content being shared".

items.title: At least four dead after storm brings flooding to southern France
items.description: The deaths include two women found drowned in a cellar in the Bouches-du-Rhône region.

items.title: El Salvador's president threatens Haitian gangs over military hostages
items.description: Four members of the so-called Gang Suppression Force have been missing since Sunday.

items.title: Two European women held captive for more than a year in Niger freed in Libya
items.description: The Swiss government told the BBC that the freed national was on her way back to Switzerland.

items.title: Celebrity shark guided out of South Korea canal refuses to swim out to sea
items.description: Bukangi the shark became an unlikely sensation after it was spotted in a canal in Busan weeks ago.

items.title: Two killed in attack on airport in eastern Saudi Arabia, authorities say
items.description: It is the latest in a series of attacks by the Houthi movement which have targeted airports and other sites in the kingdom.

items.title: First human case of Shamonda virus detected in France, officials say
items.description: The disease, which usually affects cattle, has been identified in a patient who died in early October.

items.title: Missiles hit Kyiv after Russia agrees to US call to resume Ukraine peace talks
items.description: Moscow says it is "ready in principle" to resume peace talks and US President Donald Trump says the world is "the closest we've been" to ending the war.

items.title: How do Israel's elections work and who are the main contenders?
items.description: Many view it as one of the most pivotal elections in Israel's history, with global implications.

items.title: Macron accuses foreign leaders of exploiting French riots
items.description: The comment is an apparent swipe at Benjamin Netanyahu and Donald Trump, who both face elections in coming weeks.

items.title: Meta fined $25bn for 'lies' over user data privacy
items.description: The fine is the largest to date against Facebook's owner, larger than an $18bn deal with California.

items.title: No order, no seat: Starbucks China rolls out new store policy
items.description: Starbucks says it is improving customers' in-store experience as it competes with homegrown rivals.

claude-code.name: downshift
claude-code.description: Deterministic model router and code-intelligence layer for coding agents. Right-sizes subagent models, packs only relevant code context, flags wasted prompt cache. Fail-open hooks for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and OpenCode. No LLM in the loop.

claude-code.name: moi
claude-code.description: 💾 MOI: agent-agnostic generative UI workspace. Give your agent a skill and let it build software around itself.

claude-code.name: ouroboros
claude-code.description: Agent OS: the agent gets smarter on its own. We just hold the line: Interview-gated, staged evaluation, budgeted evolution loop. MCP server, 14 runtimes: Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Copilot, Kiro and more.

claude-code.name: agent-config
claude-code.description: Every claim machine-checked, including the artifact counts in these badges — governed skills, rules and replayable state. One contract, every host agent.

claude-code.name: agent-friendly-code
claude-code.description: Scores how ready a repo is for AI coding agents, per agent. Ranked public repos, a live score for any GitHub URL, and the scorer behind the agent skill and GitHub Action.
